integrity: Proof and finite exact-rational checker included; finite enumeration is corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge clique windmills with uniformly weighted vertices and real Lipschitz functions. The complexity claim concerns binary-encoded blade sizes, not explicit adjacency input. General block graphs or nonuniform masses are not covered. Primary literature comparison has residual unindexed-equivalence risk.
title: Partition discrepancy governs sharp Lipschitz variance on clique windmills
